content: {\em 左图：}通过 [[MATH_709]] 共振产生重中微子的费曼图。{\rm 右图：}重中微子衰变长度随其质量 [[MATH_710]] 和混合参数 [[MATH_711]] 的变化（蓝色实线等值线）。红色虚线等值线表示 Br[[MATH_712]]，顶部红色阴影区域为当前 MEG 实验限制所排除的参数区间~[[CITE_713]]。灰色阴影带标出了在标准 I 型跷跷板机制下能够产生介于 [[MATH_714]] 至 0.3~eV 之间轻中微子质量标度的参数范围。

In the application of the

content: 另一种低能标LNV可以在具有{\em 自发}全局[[MATH_166]]破缺的模型中实现，这意味着存在一种无质量的Goldstone玻色子，称为Majoron~[[CITE_167]] [[COMMENT_168]]，它对[[MATH_169]]~[[CITE_170]]、轻子生成~[[CITE_171]]、暗物质~[[CITE_172]]和暴胀~[[CITE_173]]具有潜在有趣的唯象学影响。在超对称的框架下，[[MATH_174]]和[[MATH_175]]-宇称都可以通过右手标量中微子场的真空期望值自发破缺，从而导出一个最小的[[MATH_176]]-宇称破缺模型~[[CITE_177]]。
src:
An alternative low-scale LNV can be realized in models with {\em spontaneous} global [[MATH_166]] violation, which implies the existence of a massless Goldstone boson called the Majoron~[[CITE_167]]  [[COMMENT_168]]
with potentially interesting phenomenological consequences for [[MATH_169]]~[[CITE_170]], leptogenesis~[[CITE_171]], DM~[[CITE_172]] and inflation~[[CITE_173]]. In the context of supersymmetry, both [[MATH_174]] and [[MATH_175]]-parity can be spontaneously broken by the VEV of the RH sneutrino field, leading to a minimal model of [[MATH_176]]-parity violation~[[CITE_177]].

algebraic level then  in two dimensions and finally in four dimensions
both in its  non-linear  and  linear versions, has been one of 
the most fascinating discovery of the last 30 years. Besides
softening the ultraviolet behaviour of theories of fermions coupled
with bosons, supersymmetry  offered a way out, in its unbroken phase, 
to the cosmological constant problem.

content: 人们或许会问，量子引力效应是否足以解释微小的中微子质量。只要引力被微扰地处理并尊重标准模型（SM）的 [[MATH_27]] 对称性，中微子就保持无质量。然而，非微扰引力效应，例如黑洞和虫洞，并不尊重整体对称性，因而可能在低能有效拉格朗日量中诱导出非零的中微子质量。在标准模型的框架下，这些效应至多为 [[MATH_28]] eV 量级~[[CITE_29]]（其中 [[MATH_30]] 是标准模型希格斯场的真空期望值，[[MATH_31]] 是普朗克质量），这仍比满足大气中微子数据所需的质量低三个数量级~[[CITE_32]]。
src: One might wonder whether quantum gravity effects might be sufficient to explain the tiny neutrino masses. As long as gravity is treated perturbatively and respects the [[MATH_27]] symmetry of the SM, neutrinos remain massless. However, non-perturbative gravitational effects, e.g. black holes and worm holes, do not respect global symmetries and could induce non-zero neutrino masses in the effective low energy Lagrangian. In the context of the SM, these effects are at most of order [[MATH_28]] eV~[[CITE_29]] (where [[MATH_30]] is the SM Higgs VEV and [[MATH_31]] is the Planck mass), which is still three orders of magnitude below that required to satisfy the atmospheric neutrino data~[[CITE_32]].

src: Our next example regards a risk measure that has recently gained more attention, the EVaR. This measure is linked to the concept of an expectile, which is a generalized quantile function, given by [[MATH_398]], where [[MATH_399]] is an indicator function with the value [[MATH_400]] if [[MATH_401]] is true and [[MATH_402]] otherwise. [[CITE_406]] showed that the EVaR is the only coherent risk measure, beyond the mean loss, that possesses the property of elicitability, which allows a function to have its forecasts evaluated. This concept can be very useful for practical risk management in the backtesting step. Moreover, [[CITE_407]] presented empirical results that confirm the competitive performance of EVaR against other risk measures. Setting [[MATH_408]] in our functional form leads to the risk measure we refer to as Deviation EVaR (DEVaR)  [[MATH_409]]. This risk measure has not appeared in the literature before, and it is a very interesting option for risk management, due to the very recent qualities discussed for expectiles.

content: 为了解决上述问题，许多现有方法专注于利用多列结构进行人群计数，以改善特征的尺度方差 [[CITE_20]]。具体而言，它们采用多个分支，每个分支具有各自的滤波器尺寸，从而增强在不同特征分辨率下学习密度变化的能力。尽管取得了可喜的结果，但这些方法受限于两个缺点：1）大量的参数通常导致训练困难；2）无效分支的存在导致结构冗余。
src: To tackle the above issues, many existing approaches focus on improving the scale variance of features using multi-column structures for crowd counting [[CITE_20]]. Specifically, they utilize multiple branches, each of which has its own filter size, to strengthen the ability of learning density variations across diverse feature resolutions. Despite the promising results, these methods are limited by two drawbacks: 1) a large amount of parameters usually results in difficulties for training, 2) the existence of ineffective branches leads to structure redundancy.

此外，宇宙学中微子和超高频引力波也可能由这些奇异恒星气泡产生。IceCube 中微子天文台已经证实，高能宇宙中微子是揭示宇宙在电磁信号不透明波段下无遮挡图景的关键信使 [[CITE_262]]。另一方面，原初黑洞气泡可能留下频率极高的显著引力波信号，这促使人们发展超高频波段的引力波探测技术。

最后我们指出，虽然我们讨论了由原初黑洞填充的奇异恒星气泡的天体物理现象，但还存在其他类型的气泡也能产生可观测信号，例如气泡中宇宙弦的碰撞 [[CITE_263]] 和畴壁 [[CITE_264]]、气泡边界处的物质—反物质湮灭 [[CITE_265]] 等等。这些来自原初宇宙的奇异恒星气泡可以揭示隐藏在星光之中的丰富物理，值得在未来进一步探索。
src:
Additionally, cosmic neutrinos and ultra-high frequency GWs could also be generated from these exotic stellar bubbles. The IceCube Neutrino Observatory has already confirmed the high-energy cosmic neutrinos as the key messengers to reveal an unobstructed view of the Universe at wavelengths where it is opaque to EM signals [[CITE_262]]. On the other hand, the PBH bubbles may leave significant GWs of extremely high frequencies, which urges the development of GW technology in ultra-high frequency bands.
We end by mentioning that, while we have discussed astrophysical phenomena of exotic stellar bubbles filled by PBHs, there exist other types of bubbles that produce observable signals, such as collision of cosmic strings [[CITE_263]] and domain walls [[CITE_264]] in the bubbles, matter-antimatter annihilation at their boundaries [[CITE_265]], and so on. These exotic stellar bubbles from the primordial Universe can unveil rich physics hidden in the light of stars, which deserve to be explored in the future.

本研究论文提出了一项增强雾计算系统安全性的方案。通过聚焦于安全配置、跨环境安全通信以及固件重托管，所提出的方法旨在强化这些复杂系统的整体安全态势。研究活动已在开源中间件的减裁（debloating）技术开发以及利用模糊测试评估安全通信机制方面取得了可喜的成果。未来的工作将聚焦于推进嵌入式设备外设的自动建模技术。本研究为雾计算安全领域的知识增长做出了重要贡献，所提出的方法有望使整个行业受益匪浅。

[[LABEL_31]]
This research paper proposes a plan to enhance the security of fog computing systems. By focusing on secure configuration, inter-environment secure communication, and firmware rehosting, the proposed methodologies aim to strengthen the overall security posture of these complex systems. Research activities have demonstrated promising results in developing debloating techniques for open-source middleware and assessing secure communication mechanisms using fuzzing testing. Future work will focus on advancing automatic modeling techniques for embedded device peripherals. This research contributes significantly to the growth of knowledge surrounding the security of fog computing, and the proposed methodologies have the potential to greatly benefit the industry as a whole.
